title: Apply material to actors
prompt: Apply the material {root}/M_Red to material slot 0 of every Box_* actor's static mesh component.

scene.expr: len([a for a in actors if a.get_actor_label().startswith('Box')]) == 4
scene.name: 4 boxes

scene.expr: all((a.get_editor_property('static_mesh_component').get_material(0) or a).get_name() == 'M_Red' for a in [a for a in actors if a.get_actor_label().startswith('Box')])
scene.name: M_Red applied
